units.poolKey: COMBINATION C1: a high rung on a working approach
units.spine: The road into Rundgate carries steady traffic past a spread of trades wider than the town strictly needs. A stranger has its standing before anyone here gives it to him.

units.poolKey: INCOME MIX: two or three sources between them
units.spine: Anyone in the town can say what the place lives on, and the answer comes as a short list and not as one trade. Not one of those trades carries the rest.

units.poolKey: TRADE PROFILE: exports and imports both present
units.spine: The market here carries the town's own goods and other towns' goods on the same stalls. Nothing there separates what the place makes from what it brings in.
The warehouses are full of goods bound out, and no two lots are the same. This is a town that sells.
Rundgate feeds itself with a small margin left over at the end of each season.
The garrison keeps its building and the men in it keep their trade. What comes in to supply them has failed further up the chain.
A little of the trade here never reaches a clerk… small enough to annoy the clerks, too small to change what the town is. Who profits by the part that goes uncounted would be worth knowing.
